-- Prueft, ob paytrans oder invoice_id auf unsere Zahlungsvorgaenge passen.
WITH eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoJson${{ $json.datenJson }}$edoJson$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            invoice_id       text,
            paytrans         text,
            user_ref         text,
            invoice_number   text,
            amount           numeric,
            currency         text,
            status           integer,
            date_create      text,
            date_pay         text,
            date_payuntil    text,
            date_cancelled   text,
            offer_start_date text
         )
),
treffer AS (
    SELECT
        e.invoice_id,
        e.paytrans,
        e.status,
        e.amount,
        tp.booking_id AS via_paytrans,
        ti.booking_id AS via_invoice_id
    FROM eingang e
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction tp ON tp.transaction_id = e.paytrans
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction ti ON ti.transaction_id = e.invoice_id
)
SELECT 'Rechnungen eingelesen'                         AS befund, count(*)::text AS wert FROM eingang
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Zahlungsvorgaenge in der Datenbank',           count(*)::text FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction
UNION ALL
SELECT 'paytrans trifft einen Zahlungsvorgang',        count(*)::text FROM treffer WHERE via_paytrans IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'invoice_id trifft einen Zahlungsvorgang',      count(*)::text FROM treffer WHERE via_invoice_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'erreichte Buchungen ueber paytrans',           count(DISTINCT via_paytrans)::text FROM treffer WHERE via_paytrans IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Rechnungen ohne jede Zuordnung',               count(*)::text FROM treffer WHERE via_paytrans IS NULL AND via_invoice_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Summe amount aller Rechnungen',                to_char(round(sum(amount), 2), 'FM9999999990D00') FROM eingang
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Summe amount ohne Storno (status <> 3)',       to_char(round(sum(amount), 2), 'FM9999999990D00') FROM eingang WHERE status <> 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Summe aller Zahlungsvorgaenge',                to_char(round(sum(amount), 2), 'FM9999999990D00') FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Rechnungen mit status ' || status::text,       count(*)::text FROM eingang GROUP BY status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Rechnungen mit negativem Betrag',              count(*)::text FROM eingang WHERE amount < 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Rechnungen mit Zahlungseingang',               count(*)::text FROM eingang WHERE date_pay IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Rechnungsnummernkreise',                       string_agg(DISTINCT kreis, ', ')
  FROM (SELECT regexp_replace(coalesce(invoice_number, ''), '[0-9]+$', '') AS kreis FROM eingang) k
 WHERE kreis <> '';
